repos.description: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
repos.summary_zh: prompts.chat 是全球最大的开源提示词库，涵盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。提供社区驱动的提示词分享与收集平台，支持免费使用及私有化部署，兼具学术引用价值与工业级实用性。
repos.summary_en: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

repos.description: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
repos.summary_zh: Vane 是一个隐私优先的 AI 问答引擎，支持本地 LLM（Ollama）和云端大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Groq），结合互联网知识库与 SearxNG 网页搜索，提供带引用来源的精准回答。支持文件上传、多模态搜索、智能建议及本地历史记录，所有数据在本地处理以保障隐私。
repos.summary_en: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your hardware, combining internet knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq). It delivers cited answers via SearxNG-powered web search, supports file uploads, multimodal content, smart suggestions, and maintains local search history—all while keeping data private.

repos.description: A shadowsocks client for Android
repos.summary_zh: Shadowsocks Android 是一款基于 Kotlin 开发的开源代理客户端，支持 Android 和 Chrome OS 平台。该应用提供安全、快速的科学上网功能，采用 Shadowsocks 协议加密传输数据，兼容多种服务器配置，具备自动切换、流量统计等实用功能，适用于需要隐私保护和网络访问的场景。
repos.summary_en: Shadowsocks Android is an open-source proxy client built with Kotlin for Android and Chrome OS. It enables secure and fast internet access using the Shadowsocks protocol, supporting multiple server configurations, automatic switching, and traffic monitoring for enhanced privacy and network freedom.

repos.description: A proxy tool to bypass GFW.
repos.summary_zh: XX-Net 是一款运行9年的成熟翻墙工具，支持全平台多设备同时使用。其核心优势在于独创的流量混淆技术，能完美模拟Chrome浏览器行为，实现隐身级网络穿透。软件内置ChatGPT服务，提供百万级token额度，兼具隐私保护与AI生产力工具属性。
repos.summary_en: XX-Net is a mature 9-year-old circumvention tool supporting multi-platform simultaneous connections. Its core strength lies in proprietary traffic obfuscation that mimics Chrome browser behavior for stealthy network bypass. The software integrates built-in ChatGPT with one million free tokens per plan, combining privacy protection with AI productivity features.

repos.description: 🦄️ 🎃 👻 Clash Premium 规则集(RULE-SET)，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等基于 Clash Premium 内核的客户端。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供专为 Clash Premium 内核设计的规则集（RULE-SET），涵盖直连、代理和广告拦截域名列表，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等主流客户端。规则数据源自 v2ray-rules-dat、domain-list-community 等权威源，每日自动更新，支持中国大陆 IP 地址识别，适用于科学上网与网络流量精细化管控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides rule sets (RULE-SET) specifically designed for Clash Premium kernel, including direct, proxy, and ad-blocking domain lists. Compatible with ClashX Pro, Clash for Windows, and other GUI clients. Data sources include v2ray-rules-dat and domain-list-community, with daily automatic updates and support for China IP address recognition, ideal for network traffic control and bypassing restrictions.

repos.description: An Open Source YouTube app for privacy
repos.summary_zh: FreeTube 是一款注重隐私的开源桌面 YouTube 播放器，基于 Electron 跨平台运行。它通过内置提取器和 Invidious API 绕过官方接口获取视频数据，避免使用 Google 的 cookies 和 JavaScript 追踪用户行为，所有订阅、播放列表和历史记录均本地存储。支持无广告观看、频道订阅无需登录、代理连接（如 Tor）及多配置文件管理，为用户提供去中心化、反追踪的 YouTube 体验。
repos.summary_en: FreeTube is an open-source desktop YouTube player built with privacy in mind, using Electron for cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux). It bypasses official APIs via a built-in extractor or optional Invidious API to deliver ad-free videos without Google tracking through cookies or JavaScript. All data—subscriptions, playlists, and history—is stored locally. Features include anonymous channel subscriptions, proxy integration (e.g., Tor), profile-based feed organization, and full offline access to personalized content.

repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，基于 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地语音识别，支持全局快捷键录音、VAD 降噪及多平台运行，注重隐私保护且高度可扩展。
repos.summary_en: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. It offers local transcription with VAD, global hotkeys, and cross-platform support, prioritizing privacy and extensibility.

repos.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.
repos.summary_zh: MyIP 是一款功能强大的 IP 工具箱，支持多维度网络检测与隐私分析。核心功能包括：实时 IP 信息查询、WebRTC 连接检测、DNS 泄漏测试、全球节点延迟与 MTR 测试、网站可用性检查、代理规则验证及网络安全清单（258项）。支持 PWA 桌面应用、暗黑模式、键盘快捷键和多语言界面，适用于网络诊断、隐私保护和跨境访问测试。
repos.summary_en: MyIP is a comprehensive IP toolbox offering multi-dimensional network diagnostics and privacy analysis. Key features include real-time IP information lookup, WebRTC connection detection, DNS leak testing, global latency/MTR tests, website availability checks, proxy rule validation, and a 258-item cybersecurity checklist. It supports PWA desktop apps, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts, and multi-language interfaces for network troubleshooting, privacy protection, and cross-border access testing.

repos.description: An open-source, self-hosted personal AI note tool prioritizing privacy, built using TypeScript .
repos.summary_zh: Blinko 是一款开源的个人 AI 笔记工具，采用 TypeScript 和 Tauri 构建，支持自托管以保障数据隐私。其核心亮点包括基于 RAG 技术的自然语言检索、轻量级跨平台部署（支持 macOS/Windows/Android/Linux）以及 Markdown 编辑功能，让用户能快速捕捉并管理创意想法。
repos.summary_en: Blinko is an open-source, self-hosted personal AI note-taking tool built with TypeScript and Tauri. It emphasizes privacy through local data storage and offers AI-powered RAG-based retrieval, lightweight cross-platform support (macOS/Windows/Android/Linux), and Markdown editing for instant idea capture and organization.

repos.description: Bananas🍌, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
repos.summary_zh: Bananas 是一款跨平台屏幕共享工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，采用点对点连接技术，无需注册或服务器中转（仅需 STUN/TURN 和信令服务器完成初始连接）。主打隐私安全、简单易用，适合快速分享屏幕。
repos.summary_en: Bananas is a cross-platform screen sharing tool for Mac, Windows, and Linux, using peer-to-peer connections without requiring accounts or central servers (except for STUN/TURN and signaling servers). It emphasizes privacy, simplicity, and instant sharing.

repos.description: 收集一些Loon、Surge、QuantumultX、ShadowRocket、Egern的配置与去广告规则。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Loon、Surge、Quantumult X 等代理工具的配置与去广告规则，涵盖抖音、微博等主流 App 的广告过滤与 IP 修改功能，支持 MITM 响应体解析，适用于净化网络环境，提升使用体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers configuration files and ad-blocking rules for Loon, Surge, Quantumult X, and other proxy tools, including ad removal for apps like Douyin and Weibo, with MITM-based response parsing to enhance browsing experience.

repos.description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等场景，并解析《刑法》《网络安全法》等法律条文，为从业者提供合规指引，避免触碰数据安全与个人信息保护的法律红线。
repos.summary_en: This project compiles Chinese web crawler violation cases involving illegal data collection, commercial infringement, and unauthorized access. It analyzes relevant laws including the Criminal Law and Cybersecurity Law to guide practitioners in avoiding legal risks related to data compliance and personal information protection.

repos.description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。 [AD]企业租显卡算力部署AI请选Novagrid
repos.summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等五大禁区，并附相关法律法规解读与律师观点，旨在警示从业者遵守数据合规要求，规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: This project compiles illegal cases involving Chinese web crawler developers, covering five major violation zones such as privacy data scraping and commercial data infringement. It includes legal regulations and expert opinions to help practitioners comply with data compliance and avoid legal risks.

repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR for Windows 是一款基于 ShadowsocksR 协议的跨平台代理工具，专为绕过网络审查设计。支持多服务器配置、系统级代理、PAC自动更新及UDP流量转发，提供完整的隐私保护和网络访问解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR for Windows is a cross-platform proxy tool based on the ShadowsocksR protocol, designed to bypass internet censorship. It supports multiple server configurations, system-wide proxy, automatic PAC updates, and UDP forwarding, offering comprehensive privacy protection and network access.

repos.description: ShadowsocksR update rss, SSR organization https://github.com/shadowsocksr
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR C# 版本4.8.0 是一个全能代理工具，支持Socks4/4a/5、HTTP协议，具备节点统计、连接管理、UDP-over-TCP、多重代理及自定义协议插件功能。支持服务器订阅与自动更新，提供GPG签名校验确保安全性，适用于绕过网络限制与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR C# v4.8.0 is a comprehensive proxy tool supporting Socks4/4a/5, HTTP, with features like node statistics, connection management, UDP-over-TCP, multi-hop proxying, and custom protocol plugins. It supports server subscription with GPG signature verification for security, ideal for bypassing censorship and enhancing privacy.

repos.description: Free anti fingerprint browser, 指纹浏览器, 隐私浏览器, 防识别浏览器, 反识别浏览器, 防关联浏览器, 免费的web3空投专用指纹浏览器 https://virtualbrowser.cc/?src=github
repos.summary_zh: VirtualBrowser 是一款基于 Chromium 的免费反指纹浏览器，支持多环境隔离与指纹定制，可修改操作系统、代理、语言、时区等数十项指纹特征，适用于 Web3 空投防关联场景。提供自动化接口，支持 Playwright 集成，具备跨平台扩展潜力。
repos.summary_en: VirtualBrowser is a free anti-fingerprint browser based on Chromium, enabling multi-environment isolation and customizable fingerprinting. It allows modification of OS, proxy, language, timezone, and over 15+ fingerprint attributes for Web3 airdrop protection. Supports automation via Playwright and offers cross-platform expansion plans.

repos.description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
repos.summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
repos.summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

repos.description: 开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案 | 集成FunASR本地模型和可配置大语言模型的下一代中文桌面语音工作流
repos.summary_zh: 蛐蛐 (QuQu) 是一款开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案，专为中文用户打造的桌面端智能语音工作流工具。集成阿里巴巴 FunASR 本地语音识别模型和可配置大语言模型，实现高精度中文识别与智能文本优化，支持隐私保护、国产 AI 模型适配及开发者友好功能，完全免费且跨平台。
repos.summary_en: QuQu is an open-source, free alternative to Wispr Flow, designed as a next-generation Chinese desktop voice workflow tool. It integrates Alibaba's FunASR local speech recognition model with configurable large language models, enabling high-precision Chinese transcription and intelligent text optimization. Features include privacy protection, support for domestic AI models, and developer-friendly formatting, all completely free and cross-platform.

repos.description: [NeurIPS 2024] DreamClear: High-Capacity Real-World Image Restoration with Privacy-Safe Dataset Curation
repos.summary_zh: DreamClear 是 NeurIPS 2024 论文提出的高容量真实世界图像修复系统，通过隐私安全的语料库构建技术，实现高质量图像恢复。其核心创新在于结合 PixArt-α 生成模型与多模态对齐能力，支持文本引导修复，并在 RealLQ250 基准测试中表现优异，适用于摄影、遥感等真实场景。
repos.summary_en: DreamClear, presented at NeurIPS 2024, is a high-capacity real-world image restoration framework featuring privacy-safe dataset curation. It leverages the PixArt-α generative model with multimodal alignment for text-guided restoration, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the RealLQ250 benchmark across diverse real-world scenarios including photography and remote sensing.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-iOS
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 Shadowsocks 的下一代 macOS 客户端，提供高性能代理功能，支持 SSR 协议，适用于科学上网与隐私保护。项目因监管要求已停止维护，原代码存档于 shadowsocksr-backup 仓库。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, offering high-performance proxy capabilities with SSR protocol support for secure browsing and privacy protection. The project has been discontinued due to regulatory reasons, with archived code in the shadowsocksr-backup repository.

repos.description: Open-source Android vault app to hide photos, videos, audio, notes & documents securely with AES encryption
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: 临时邮箱 - 匿名的一次性邮箱（无需登录，打开即用）
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Golang + Astro + React 构建的匿名临时邮箱服务，支持长轮询实时接收邮件、CSS样式隔离、暗色主题切换及附件下载，无需登录即可快速注册保护隐私，适用于防垃圾邮件和批量账号注册场景。
repos.summary_en: Anonymous disposable email service built with Golang, Astro, and React, featuring real-time email delivery via long polling, CSS isolation, dark mode, and attachment support—ideal for privacy protection and spam-free account registration.

repos.description: 👾 DX-focused decentralized zero-knowledge framework 🛸
repos.summary_zh: HyperspaceZK 是一个面向开发者的去中心化零知识证明框架，专注于提供简洁的 API 和完整的工具链，用于构建隐私保护型应用。它基于通用零知识证明系统，无需可信设置，支持高可靠性、模块化集成与开箱即用体验，适用于区块链与 Web3 场景中的隐私计算需求。
repos.summary_en: HyperspaceZK is a developer-centric decentralized zero-knowledge framework designed to simplify building privacy-preserving applications on top of generalized ZK proof systems. It offers an intuitive API, extensive tooling, and no trusted setup, enabling secure, verifiable computation with seamless integration into modern web and blockchain stacks.
